text: In 1971, a crisis in East Pakistan pushed India and Pakistan toward their third war.
On the third of December, Pakistani jets struck Indian airfields, and war began.
Indian forces drove into the east, with tanks and infantry advancing from three sides.
On the western front, armour and artillery clashed along the border near Lahore.
In thirteen days it was over. On the sixteenth of December, Pakistani forces in Dhaka surrendered.
